passages.text: These are the things that you shall do: speak every man the truth with his neighbor. Execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates, and let none of you devise evil in your hearts against his neighbor, and love no false oath: for all these are things that I hate,” says Yahweh.
Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you.
passages.note: holding on to hope; restoration after loss
